name: OMTArchy - NYC Subway MTA
author: tirade
description: Live NYC subway arrivals for any station from the MTA's GTFS-realtime feeds — no API key needed. Shows the next trains in the bar and a full detail popup: whole-station boards (even Times Sq, across every feed), each train's real destination, service alerts split from planned work, elevator and escalator outages, a trip planner that knows when an express transfer beats riding direct, per-train stop lists, leave-now reminders, and favorite stations with automatic AM/PM commute switching.

barWidget.description: Next arrivals at a subway station, in the bar and in a detail popup. Tap "Change" in the popup to search or browse by line for a station.

schema.label: Line group
schema.description: Which MTA GTFS-realtime feed to poll for any Stop ID below that doesn't name its own. Set automatically when you pick a station with "Change" in the popup; only matters if you're typing a Stop ID by hand.

schema.label: Stop ID
schema.description: GTFS stop_id for the station. Normally set for you by the in-popup station picker — this field is a manual fallback. Can be a comma-separated list to track a whole complex as one board; each entry may name its own feed as stopId:feedGroup (e.g. 127:1234567S,R16:NQRW,A27:ACE for Times Sq), which is what tapping a station's name in the picker sets.

schema.label: Direction
schema.description: both shows an Uptown/Downtown toggle in the popup. N or S locks the popup to just that direction (N = uptown/northbound, S = downtown/southbound).

schema.label: Routes (optional)
schema.description: Comma-separated route IDs to show, e.g. 1,2,3. Blank shows every route serving this stop. Toggled by clicking the line circles in the popup (or one line's bullet in the station picker); "Select all" clears it.

schema.label: Arrivals shown
schema.description: How many upcoming trains to list for the selected direction/route.

schema.label: Refresh interval (ms)
schema.description: MTA feeds update roughly every 30s, so that's also the shortest interval allowed.

schema.label: Trains in the bar
schema.description: How many upcoming trains the bar lists, e.g. "⬆❹ · 2m, 6m".

schema.label: Walk to station (min)
schema.description: Minutes on foot to the station. Above 0, the bar skips trains you can no longer make and says when to leave, and a train's "Remind me" fires this long before it arrives. 0 turns this off.

schema.label: Commute mode
schema.description: Switch to your AM favorite before the switch hour and your PM favorite after it. Tag favorites by right-clicking them in the popup.

schema.label: Commute switch hour
schema.description: Hour of the day (0-23) when commute mode switches from the AM favorite to the PM one.

schema.label: Alert notifications
schema.description: Desktop notification when a new delay appears on this station's selected lines. commute: only while commute mode has you on your AM or PM station. always: whatever station is tracked.

schema.label: Detailed notifications
schema.description: Off: notifications only say that something happened ("Time to leave for your train"), and clicking one opens the popup. On: they also name your station, line and stop. Notification text is handed to Omarchy's notification command as program arguments, which other accounts on a shared computer may be able to see while it runs.

schema.label: Bar label override
schema.description: Short name shown in the bar, e.g. Times Sq. Defaults to the station's name.
